<div class="card-body">
'''General Veers''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヴィアーズ将軍</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">オゼル提督と同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋1。ホスの同じ位置にいる帝国軍はそれぞれ戦闘力＋1。操縦する戦闘用ビークルの戦闘力に3を加える。「ブリザード1」上では装甲値に1を加え、戦闘運命数が引けない場合にも1枚引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-General-Veers-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">マクシミリアン・ヴィアーズ将軍は帝国地上軍将校の模範である。狡猾で忠誠心が強く、敵にとっては致命的までに有能な<u>リーダー</u>。ベイダーの軍団で地上攻撃部隊を指揮する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' General Veers

'''Card text:''' Power +1 if at the same location as Admiral Ozzel. Each Imperial at the same location on Hoth has power +1. Adds 3 to the power of the combat vehicle he pilots. On Blizzard 1, adds 1 to armor and may draw one battle destiny even when unable to draw one otherwise.

'''Lore:''' General Maximilian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. A cunning and loyal leader, so capable as to be deadly to his enemies. Commands the ground assault troops in Vader's forces.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[General Veers]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
